## Episode Thesis

This Danish personal-finance episode is about switching banks to get a cheaper home loan. One host says two bank switches cut her cooperative-housing loan interest by about DKK 17,000 a year. Guest Jens Jarsbæk, chief economist at Mybanker, explains that bank-set rate ranges vary widely, mortgage-credit loan rates can't be negotiated but the bank-financed top-up can, and switching fees can often be negotiated away. There is no equity or market discussion, and no investment views are given on any company.
